walkthroughs.body_html:
Renewables won't run out: solar, wind, hydro, tidal, wave, biomass, geothermal.

Non-renewables will run out: coal, oil, natural gas, nuclear fuel.

Non-renewables are often cheap and reliable but release CO2 or radioactive waste.

Efficiency tells you how much energy is useful and not wasted.

A modern LED bulb is about 90% efficient.

An old filament bulb was only 5% efficient - the rest came out as wasted heat!

Efficiency = useful energy out / total energy in.

A Sankey diagram shows energy flow with arrows.

The width of each arrow = amount of energy.

Useful energy goes one way (often right), wasted energy splits off (often down).

The total width going in always equals the total going out - that's conservation!
